tasks.prompt: Test resource optimizations: Run 15 parallel agents and verify memory stays under 400MB total, CPU usage scales across cores, no memory leaks after 100 task executions.
Commit resource optimizations with message 'perf: reduce memory usage by 50% and add multiprocessing support'.
Refactor GenericOrchestrator god object. Extract responsibilities into: TaskScheduler, WorkflowEngine, MetricsCollector, StateManager. Each class under 500 lines. Maintain public API compatibility.

Replace singleton pattern with dependency injection. Create OrchestratorFactory with configurable providers. Implement interfaces for TokenProvider, FileHandler, MessageBus. Enable testing with mock implementations.

Add behavior to data classes following DDD principles. Enhance AgentTask with: validate(), execute(), retry() methods. Create TaskResult value object with success/failure factory methods. Implement Task aggregate root.

Create integration test suite for refactored architecture. Test: all workflows still execute correctly, backwards compatibility maintained, new components integrate properly. Must achieve 90% code coverage.
Commit architectural improvements with message 'refactor: eliminate god object and singleton anti-patterns using SOLID principles'.

Run comprehensive benchmarks comparing refactored vs baseline. Generate comparison report showing: throughput improvement %, memory reduction %, CPU utilization improvement. Must show 2x improvement in at least 2 metrics.

Update all documentation to reflect new architecture. Update: ARCHITECTURE.md with new component design, API_REFERENCE.md with new classes, DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md with new patterns. Include migration guide for existing users.
Perform security audit on refactored code. Check: no new vulnerabilities introduced, token handling remains secure, file permissions properly set, no sensitive data logged.
Final review of all changes. Verify: all tests pass, documentation complete, performance targets met, backwards compatibility maintained. Create final approval report.
Create pull request from refactor/performance-improvements to main branch. Include: performance metrics, test results, breaking changes (if any). Merge after all checks pass.
